title: fix(ui): prevent tooltip wrapper from blocking mobile button taps
author: Saauf

gist.summary: Fixed tooltip behavior that prevented taps on mobile action buttons, such as Edit and Delete, from opening their dialogs. Non-interactive tooltip spans no longer receive the `polli-control` class and its 44px touch-target overlay. Tooltips now ignore touch pointer-enter events and open on focus only for keyboard-visible focus, avoiding popup changes that could swallow a tap. Tests cover `polli-control` on span triggers and button controls.
